Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in InPage word processor to execute shellcode hidden in INP file header, which decrypts itself, dumps an EXE file on victim's PC, and runs it to install backdoors or keyloggers written in Visual C++, Visual Basic, or Delphi
Impacted Systems: Financial institutions and government agencies in Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Uganda
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with malicious INP file attachments
